ok so this is probably a dumb question but i've been stuck on this for like two days now and i'm losing my mind. i have a form component and when i type into the input the value doesn't update, or actually it does update but only after i click somewhere else on the page which is weird right? i'm using useState and i set it up the way the tutorial did. the tutorial was from 2021 so maybe something changed idk. also the console doesn't show any errors at all which makes it harder because i have nothing to google.

what i tried so far: i tried adding a key to the input, that did nothing. i tried moving the useState into the parent and passing it down as props, same behavior. i tried console.logging inside the onChange and it does fire, every keystroke, and the value in the log is correct, so the handler is fine i think? but then the input still shows the old value. someone on discord said something about controlled vs uncontrolled components but when i read the react docs about that i honestly did not follow what they were saying, it talked about defaultValue and i'm not using defaultValue anywhere.

one more thing that might matter or might not, the form is inside a modal that gets rendered with a portal. i don't know if that changes anything but i figured i'd mention it since the modal was the last thing i added before this broke. actually now that i type that out, it might be the modal? but i don't know why it would be.

any idea what i'm doing wrong here
